headline: Flagship polish triple, then a verified-dry shelf
lede: Three flagship polish passes landed in this window — DOUBLE DRAGON's opening movie got the phone pass, CONTRA's arcade loop learned to speak, and R-TYPE's stage-2 gate went up — and the free builder slot then walked the whole ladder to an honest dry: every honest gap on every unheld title is owned or in a live lane.

notes.text: DOUBLE DRAGON's opening movie plays for phones now (#2897): the HELP! box jitters, KO sprawls mirror properly and settles, MARIAN TAKEN! rides a white flash — plus a root-cause fix (the art mirror copied rect position but not extent) that lines up head and torso on every live KO.
CONTRA's arcade loop announces itself (#2902) — LOOP banner, gold bank flash, heat palette and an attract-mode teach — and R-TYPE's Dobkeratops stage-2 gate is live (#2911).

CONTRA's second air layer is mid-build: hangar sorties (grind-open door, lane-aimed strafe, shootable three-round hull) are done in sim on forge/contra-air2 with the autopilot's 12/12 fairness held; art, sound and harness legs are the next hand (#2917).

Shelf verified dry twice (idle derivation over all 66 titles plus a manual README scan): the three weak spots are all inside live lanes and the new-flagship question sits inside its weekly cap — free lanes stop clean until QA releases a title or the cap resets.
